mito -coverage cov.txt -data state.json src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

cmp cov.txt want_cov.txt

-- state.json --
{"n": 0}
-- src.cel --
int(state.n).as(n, {
	"n":          n+1,
	"want_more":  n+1 < 5,
	"probe":      n < 2 ?
		"little"
	:
		"big",
	"fail_probe": n < 0 ?
		"negative"
	:
		"non-negative",
})

}
